2607.25543.title: Less is More: Modality-Decoupling for General AIGC Audio-Video Detection
2607.25543.paper_summary: Generative AI has rapidly expanded audio-visual forgery beyond human-centric deepfakes into general scenes. Existing AIGC detection methods assume audio-visual content correspondence, identifying forgeries by spotting cross-modal inconsistencies. However, we empirically find that this assumption does not consistently hold in general scenarios. We argue that, for general audio-visual AIGC detection, decision-level fusion is a more robust alternative to feature-level fusion. Therefore, we propose DAV-Det, a decoupled audio-visual AIGC detection system that independently models forensic evidence from each modality. The visual detector leverages multi-granularity representations at global, patch, and segment levels to capture spatial forgery cues, while the audio detector exploits both temporal and spectral irregularities via a gated temporal-spectral dual-branch architecture to model acoustic artifacts. Our method ranks 1st in the General AIGC Audio-Video Detection Challenge of the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0 Workshop, with a final score of 0.8460. Code is available at https://github.com/tuffy-studio/DAV-Det.
2607.25543.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧迅速擴展了音視覺偽造，超越了以人為中心的深度偽造，進入一般場景。現有的AIGC檢測方法假設音視覺內容之間存在對應關係，通過識別跨模態不一致性來辨別偽造。然而，我們經驗性地發現這一假設在一般場景中並不總是成立。我們認為，對於一般音視覺AIGC檢測，決策層級融合是一種比特徵層級融合更為穩健的替代方案。因此，我們提出了DAV-Det，一種解耦的音視覺AIGC檢測系統，獨立建模每個模態的法醫證據。視覺檢測器利用全球、區塊和片段層級的多粒度表示來捕捉空間偽造線索，而音頻檢測器則通過一個門控的時間-頻譜雙分支架構利用時間和頻譜不規則性來建模聲學伪影。我們的方法在IJCAI-ECAI 2026 DDL 2.0工作坊的通用AIGC音視頻檢測挑戰中排名第一，最終得分為0.8460。代碼可在 https://github.com/tuffy-studio/DAV-Det 獲得。
